headline: Kuura Strand Erupts as Nevish Line Battle Grinds On
war_summary: Since the last edition, the map of violence has shifted. Kuura Strand, silent at the previous filing, burst into action with ten base events in the final two hours and a closing toll of 227 Colonial and 46 Warden casualties — the sharpest new surge on any front. The Nevish Line remains the war's busiest ground with forty-six actions in a day, and the Colonial flag now flies over five of its eight posts, a lead taken from the even split last reported, with Grief Mother and Blackcoat Way again the storm centers. Palantine Berm logged thirty-six actions in the day, though its guns fell silent several hours before press time. Callahan's Passage shows no fresh base events in the closing hours, yet its two-hour casualty bill still ran near 1,300 a side. The Weathered Expanse carried on with twenty-seven actions, Warden losses running half again heavier than Colonial. Mooring County's posts were quiet at the wire, but its casualty rate climbed steeply, and at Viper Pit the Colonials took Blackthroat late in the day. It is day 479; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is named.
